admin.agent.skill_hint: Copy this prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw…), then send it the key you issued under Agents. The agent saves each project's URL and key in a private local credentials file (readable only by you), never in a repository. For several ShipAny projects, copy the prompt from this page on each site. Note: the key stays in the chat history — revoke it under Agents if it leaks or is no longer needed.
admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a ShipAny project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the shipany-admin skill yet, download these two files into a shipany-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/shipany-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → shipany-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → shipany-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.

admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.

lp.faq.label: FAQ
lp.faq.title: Good things to know
lp.faq.a1: Pavo AI is an all-in-one AI video generator with 20+ leading models. Describe a scene for text to video, or upload a photo for image to video; generate videos, images, avatars, music and voice, then edit and download without leaving the studio.
lp.faq.q2: How much does Pavo AI cost?
lp.faq.a2: Every new Pavo AI account starts with 25 credits, no card required. When you need more, one-time packs start at $15 and never expire.
lp.faq.q3: How do I make an AI video from text or a photo?
lp.faq.a3: Open the Pavo AI Video Studio, type what you want to see (or drop in a photo to animate), pick a model like Veo or Kling, and press Create. Most text to video and image to video clips are ready in under two minutes.
lp.faq.q4: Can I keep characters consistent across shots?
lp.faq.a4: Yes, the Pavo AI Timeline links scenes together with a reference character, so your cast stays the same from shot to shot and take to take.
lp.faq.q5: Can I edit my videos with AI?
lp.faq.a5: Trim and arrange takes in the Pavo AI AI video editor, restyle a clip, upscale to 4K, add subtitles in 98 languages or dub into 33, all without leaving the studio.
lp.faq.q6: Do I need a subscription? Do credits expire?
lp.faq.a6: No subscription. You pay once for a credit pack and use it whenever you like, Pavo AI credits never expire.
lp.faq.q7: Can I use what I create commercially?
lp.faq.a7: Yes. Everything you generate with Pavo AI paid credits is licensed for commercial use, with no watermarks on exports.
lp.faq.q8: Which AI model should I choose?
lp.faq.a8: Each Pavo AI model has its own strengths: Veo for realism, Kling for camera work, Sora for creative range. If unsure, start with the default; you can compare takes side by side.

lp.guide.label: Why Pavo AI
lp.guide.title: An AI video generator built for people who ship
lp.guide.intro: Most AI video tools do one thing well and stop there. Pavo AI is the all-in-one AI video generator that puts the whole pipeline under one roof, so an idea can go from prompt to published clip inside Pavo AI without a subscription stack or a render farm.
lp.guide.b1t: Text to Video AI Generator — From One Sentence
lp.guide.b1: Type what you want to see and press create. The Pavo AI text to video studio runs your prompt on Veo, Kling, Sora and 20+ more models, so you can compare takes, pick the winner and iterate until the shot is right. Script a scene, describe a product spin, or storyboard a whole ad in an afternoon, all inside Pavo AI.
lp.guide.b2t: Image to Video AI That Keeps Your Subject
lp.guide.b2: Upload a photo and the Pavo AI image to video studio animates it: a product turntable from one packshot, a talking avatar from a portrait, a cinematic push-in from a still. Reference locking carries character and product details across shots, which is what makes multi-scene videos usable for real campaigns on Pavo AI.
lp.guide.b3t: AI Video Editor in the Same Window
lp.guide.b3: Generation is half the job. The Pavo AI video editor trims and arranges takes, restyles footage, upscales to 4K, writes and burns subtitles in 98 languages, dubs voices in 33, and scores the cut with generated music. Exports carry no watermark and are licensed for commercial use on every Pavo AI plan.
lp.guide.b4: Teams use Pavo AI as their AI video generator for ads, social clips, product pages and pitch videos. Start with 25 starter Pavo AI credits and no card; top up once, from $15, when a project needs volume. Credits never expire, so the balance you buy this quarter still ships next quarter.
